content: Fan-out/fan trap: joining a table to a many-to-many related table before aggregating multiplies rows (e.g. joining publications to publication_authors to publication_sdgs in one query), so SUM/COUNT on the joined result silently over-counts. Standard fix is to aggregate each many-side relation independently (or in a subquery/CTE at its own grain) before joining the pre-aggregated results together, so no aggregate function ever runs against a fanned-out row set.
